reader.requirement: At --std 85 a REDEFINES clause must come right after data-name-1 or FILLER, or right after the level-number when the subject is omitted (§1985:VI.5.3.3 SR2); after any other clause it must be refused, in every section.

edition-consulted.switches: whether the word after the level-number is read as the entry-name depends on the edition's reservation (ReservedGatedWord)

reader.edition-search: ScreenLeadingClausePosition takes the clause list's ordinal (REDEFINES must be clause 0) with no DialectLevel test (grep DialectLevel/Edition. in DataBinder.ClausePlacement.cs around LeadingClauses); the TYPEDEF row of LeadingClauses is unreachable at 85 because VersionConformancePass refuses TYPEDEF.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the only edition input is which words are reserved, so a 2002-only word (TYPEDEF, NATIONAL) is a valid 1985 subject
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover REDEFINES after PICTURE and after GLOBAL; the other clauses, the omitted-subject and FILLER forms, and the file and linkage sections are not exercised

probes.expected: legal right after the level-number (VI.5.3.3 SR2)

probes.printed: COBOL2739 the REDEFINES clause follows USAGE

probes.expected: refused: no subject, so it must follow the level-number

probes.printed: COBOL2739 for B (file section) and LB (linkage section)

probes.expected: legal in a file record and in working storage; written, read back and updated through the redefinition
TYPEDEF and NATIONAL are not reserved in 1985, so they are subjects and REDEFINES follows them

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.10.3 SR1  (5.10.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1
OK  §1985:VI.5.3.3 SR2  (5.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

reader.notes: The free-order clause list is screened by position: REDEFINES must be the first clause after the optional subject. Every 1985 clause placed before it is refused, and the omitted-subject form is accepted. At --std 2023 rd_after_usage draws the same COBOL2739.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VI.5.10.3 SR1, the definition Subject of Entry (operand or reserved word immediately after the level-number) and §1985:VI.5.3.3 SR2 (REDEFINES follows data-name-1/FILLER, otherwise the level-number). Probes at --std 85: rd_comma (01 B, REDEFINES A; PIC X(4). and 01 C REDEFINES, A PIC XX.) accepted, printed ABCD AB (separators are not clauses); rd_77ok (77 B REDEFINES A) printed AB; rd_77bad (77 B PIC X(2) REDEFINES A) COBOL2739 follows PICTURE; rd_after_global (01 B GLOBAL REDEFINES A) COBOL2739; rd_sub_after_pic (05 B PIC 9(4) REDEFINES A) COBOL2739; rd_after_occurs_group (05 B OCCURS 2 REDEFINES A) COBOL2739; rd_after_usage_nosubj (05 USAGE DISPLAY REDEFINES A) COBOL2739 'FILLER' follows USAGE; rd_sub_nosubj_ok (05 REDEFINES A PIC X(2)) printed ABCDE; rd_85words2 (VALIDATE, PROPERTY, RAISE as 1985 subjects) printed ABCD AB A; rd_commsec (Communication Section 05 B PIC X(4) REDEFINES A) COBOL2739 (plus the CD record-length COBOL6169). DataBinder.ClausePlacement.cs carries no DialectLevel test (grep). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.10.3 SR1; OK §1985:VI.5.3.3 SR2.
